verdict.rationale: Sentry documents its own dashboards: widgets that visualize datasets across multiple projects, plus global filters that apply to every widget, which roughly resemble template variables. It does not document sharing, the range of visualization types, or true templated variables. missing for 10: evidence of shareable dashboards (links/permissions/export), an enumerated set of rich visualization types, true template variables beyond global filters, dashboards-as-code definition, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can build shareable dashboards with rich visualization types and template variables

citations.quote: Dashboards are made up of one or more widgets, and each widget visualizes one or more dataset.
All widgets in the same view reflect the results of the global filters set at the top of the dashboard.
allowing you to navigate through error and performance data across multiple projects
